_comment: THE [Rogue] EARN CANONICAL -- fixture-first proof of earn -> sleep -> class_gained -> [Stealth] fielded (the project's ratified fixture-first policy for new canonicals, named explicitly for this class in the K3 canon-verdicts packet).
